behavior: NC-T01 physical wrapper now creates the runtime guard before remote D1 construction or official-source access.
Runner-local D1 enforcement permits only SELECT/WITH/PRAGMA semantics and rejects mutation or multi-statement SQL before Cloudflare transport.
Physical fetch is constrained to a frozen canonical-origin contract and checks every redirect hop before transport.
Runtime evidence is ledger-derived from measured D1/network/capability counters; runtimeForbiddenAccessCount is no longer a literal.

The ledger binds the isolated system2-research database identity, allowed read counts, mutation rejections, rows read/written, observed origins, allowed/forbidden network counts and forbidden capability attempts.
The measured runtimeEvidenceDigest is bound through hidden-fallback auditDigest and HIDDEN_FALLBACK_AUDIT_SHA256 into the final NC-T01 receiptHash.
Hidden-fallback audit finalizes only after SHORT_MOMENTUM orchestration; any guarded activity after the audit cut changes the ledger and fails the wrapper.
Post-run rowsWritten=0 remains a second-line physical readback.
The real physical workflow is workflow_dispatch-only and requires a repo-local continuity receipt path; PR/push does not execute the real Cloudflare/TWSE/TPEx physical run.
